id_and_class.theory_title: Johnson and Debold’s Urantia Theocosmic Cosmopsychism
id_and_class.summary: Drawing on The Urantia Book, JJ Johnson and Bob Debold describe consciousness as personal participation in a mind-architecture that flows from an infinite, personal Deity. Cosmic mind mediates between spirit and matter, individual minds reflect this order instead of producing it, and personality, a unique gift from Deity, unifies each person’s mind across levels of existence.
id_and_class.core_identity_tagline: Consciousness as Participation in Divine Mind

conceptual_ground.explanatory_identity_claim: Consciousness is personal participation in a hierarchical, Deity-originated cosmic mind that mediates between spirit and matter.
conceptual_ground.mind_body_relationship: The model posits three domains (spirit, mind, and matter). Mind is a mediating ‘living presence’ that unites energy systems with intelligence and cannot be reduced to physics or to pure subjectivity, so neural activity expresses mind without producing it.
conceptual_ground.emergence_type: Not applicable (mind flows top-down from an infinite personal source; individual minds are finite participations in it)
conceptual_ground.subjectivity_and_intentionality: Personality, a non-replicable endowment from Deity, makes consciousness someone’s. It unifies mental states, grounds free will and moral responsibility, and lets finite selves align with universal mind while staying individual.
conceptual_ground.qualia_account: Johnson and Debold address the hard problem by rooting awareness in a triune structure of fact, meaning, and value, matched to scientific, philosophical, and religious ways of knowing. They give no separate account of qualitative feel.
conceptual_ground.ontological_commitments: A personal infinite Deity; cosmic mind; spirit, mind, and matter as distinct domains; personality as a bestowed unifying principle; morontial (transitional) and spiritual levels of existence; an inhabited universe under the same mindal governance.
conceptual_ground.epistemic_access: Through revelation (The Urantia Book) coordinated with science and philosophy under Johnson’s COSAR principle (Coordination of Science and Religion).
conceptual_ground.constituents_and_structure: A graded ladder of mind: instinctive consciousness in animals, human self-consciousness, and the capacity to recognize and respond to divine personality, all ordered top-down from Deity.

mechanism_and_dynamics.scope_of_consciousness: Phenomenal, Self-awareness, Personal identity, Free will, Moral and spiritual awareness
mechanism_and_dynamics.distinctive_mechanism_or_principle: Personality as integrator. It unifies mental states and keeps identity continuous across material, morontial, and spiritual levels, and Johnson says it ‘cosars’ the whole spectrum of consciousness into one experiential continuum.
mechanism_and_dynamics.dynamics_of_emergence: Consciousness rises through progressively higher levels of mindal participation, from instinct to self-consciousness to awareness of Deity. Individuals can keep progressing beyond material life through morontial and spiritual stages.
mechanism_and_dynamics.location_and_distribution: Mind operates on a cosmic scale across an inhabited universe; each individual mind is a local participation in it.
mechanism_and_dynamics.causation_and_functional_role: Cosmic mind organizes spiritual patterns and physical energies into working relations, and in persons it supports free will and moral choice.
mechanism_and_dynamics.integration_or_binding: Personality binds mental states into one continuous identity across all levels of existence.
mechanism_and_dynamics.evolutionary_account: Animals show instinctive consciousness and humans self-consciousness, but these steps reflect degrees of participation in a pre-existing mindal order rather than consciousness arising from matter.
core_claims_and_evidence: Consciousness originates in an infinite personal source and descends through levels of mind, which sets the model apart from impersonal cosmopsychism.
Mind is a third domain between spirit and matter and reduces to neither.
Any adequate account of consciousness must coordinate fact, meaning, and value across science, philosophy, and religion (the COSAR principle).

Michael Levin’s findings on bioelectric pattern memory in planaria and on synthetic ‘anthrobots’ suggest cognition can occur outside neural substrates, which Johnson and Debold read as support for a mind-architecture guiding form across scales.
mechanism_and_dynamics.basis_of_belief_or_evidence_type: Revelatory (The Urantia Book), supported by philosophical integration and selected biological findings

empirics_and_critiques.criticisms_and_tensions: The model rests on The Urantia Book, whose revelatory status is claimed by its readers and not independently established, so its central claims stand or fall with acceptance of that text.
empirics_and_critiques.ontological_coherence: Johnson and Debold place the model at the idealist edge of the landscape, as a theistic extension of analytic cosmopsychism (Shani, Albahari, Goff, Kastrup). Like Integrated Information Theory it grades consciousness, but by degree of mindal participation instead of causal complexity, and like Whitehead it treats experience as pervasive while grounding it in personal Deity instead of abstract creativity.

AI_consciousness.rationale: Since personal consciousness depends on personality bestowed by Deity, a machine built from matter alone would lack what makes a mind personal.

survival_beyond_death.rationale: Personality keeps identity continuous across material, morontial, and spiritual levels, so the person continues beyond bodily death.

meaning_and_purpose.rationale: Consciousness flows from a personal and purposive Deity, and finite minds progressively align with universal mind.

virtual_immortality.rationale: Personality is described as a unique, non-replicable endowment, which follows against copying a person into a digital system.
